'''Outpost Thorazan''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] outpost in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] region of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Outpost Thorazan was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It appears as one of the Republic settlements on the planet Tatooine.
